svg.title: The trip list flow
svg.desc: Now, a click on a trip replaces the list with its page. Proposed, a click selects and previews; opening is a separate, deliberate step, and Back returns to the list as it was.
svg.text: A click opens the trip, so the list is gone and the next trip is a Back and a click away.
Every click on a trip replaces the list with that trip’s page.
Comparing trips means Back, find the row, click, Back again,
and the list loses its place each time.
Selecting and opening are the same gesture.
Selecting previews. Opening is its own, deliberate step.
‹ Trips: back to the same row, the same scroll, the same selection
The right panel and the map follow the selection in every state.
